title: ‘She's our idol’: Pinoy fans cheer on Anna Leigh Waters at Franklin Asia Pickleball Showcase
summary: The Filipino fans of pickleball star Anna Leigh Waters were all smiles as they watched the World No. 1 play at the Franklin Asia Pickleball Showcase at the Mall of Asia in Pasay City.
